caption: The browser walks the named controls in order and builds the query string for a GET form. The select contributes lang=en and the submit button contributes nothing, because it has no name.

spec.title: Submitting a search form with GET
spec.aria: A form with action /search and method get holds a text input named q and a select named lang; pressing the submit button builds the URL /search?q=html&lang=en.
